environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EC2 in a public subnet with an internet-facing ALB. MongoDB Atlas cluster with peering connection. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No request filtering or input validation middleware. Service is documented as 'internal only' but the ALB target group is publicly routable.

config.mongodb: Atlas M10 cluster, peered VPC, no IP whitelist beyond VPC CIDR
